integrity: Exact algebraic checks and complete proof-to-source comparison were conducted; the result remains subject to independent mathematical evaluation.
scientific_limitations: Only real polynomial maps of dimensions at least three with noninjectivity on real points and nonzero constant Jacobian are classified.
The proof relies on classical Hurwitz–Radon and Adams nonsingular matrix-space theorems, not computational extrapolation.
Characteristic-positive fields, the two-variable Jacobian question, and classification of extremal subspaces are not settled.
Novelty over unindexed literature cannot be certified by finite searches.
title: Sharp Hurwitz–Radon lineability of real Keller counterexamples
